description.value:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a mental effect, but you haven't rolled yet.

You clutch a memento from your past life—the time before you gained self-awareness and awakened as yourself—and you use it to fuel your defiance in the face of injustice, bolster your confidence in times of self-doubt, and remind you of the miracle of your independence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus also applies to the triggering save.
